_about: Overnight Oct 23, Part 1: scripted mid-fight events for bosses and elites (EncounterScripts, core/dungeon/encounter_scripts.gd). Keyed like modifiers.json. Each trigger fires once: when {type: hp_below pct | turn turn | units_died count side card | foe_units_at_least count | own_units_at_most count | foe_hp_below pct}; effects in order (rule, remove_rule, summon, card, heal, shield, damage, resources, buff, debuff_foes, exhaust_foes, draw, foe_heal, exhaust_own). text = what can happen (shown with the rule icons from the start), line = the foe's line when it fires, banner = what just happened, warn = the one-line warning the turn before a timed event. Generated from _logs/make_scripts.js; edit either.

Hollow Warden.name: The Warden Stirs
Hollow Warden.text: At half health the Warden wakes a little more: a 1/1 Cave Echo rises beside it.
Hollow Warden.line: ...You hit like someone I knew. Small. Stubborn.
Hollow Warden.banner: A 1/1 Cave Echo rises beside the Warden.

town:npc:beefcake.name: HYDRATION BREAK
town:npc:beefcake.text: At half health Brick stops to drink: he heals 3, and his units stand down through his next turn.
town:npc:beefcake.line: HYDRATION BREAK. NOBODY LIFTS DURING HYDRATION. THAT IS THE LAW. ...It is a good law.
town:npc:beefcake.banner: Brick heals 3. His units are exhausted and miss his next turn.

town:npc:gourmand.name: TASTE IT!
town:npc:gourmand.text: At half health Fennel force-feeds you a biscuit (you heal 2) and a 1/1 Snack joins his side.
town:npc:gourmand.line: TASTE IT. It is for the war effort. The BISCUIT is for the war effort.
town:npc:gourmand.banner: You heal 2. A 1/1 Snack joins Fennel.

town:npc:refusemancer.name: Did I Thorn at You?
town:npc:refusemancer.text: At half health the real Moss breaks through for a moment: the thorns loosen and you heal 3.
town:npc:refusemancer.line: ...grow... GROW... (small) Did I thorn at you? I'm sorry, I can't make it stop...

town:npc:necrocrat.name: Stamped APPROVED
town:npc:necrocrat.text: At half health Prudence grabs the wrong stamp: APPROVED. You heal 3.
town:npc:necrocrat.line: APPROVED. ...That was the wrong stamp. That felt... nice. Disregard.
town:npc:necrocrat.banner: Prudence stamps APPROVED by mistake: you heal 3.

town:graveyard.name: The Count Pauses
town:graveyard.text: At half health the dead lose count: their units stand still through their next turn.
town:graveyard.line: The counting stops. Somewhere under the stones, someone has lost their place.
town:graveyard.banner: The dead stand still: their units miss their next turn.

town:graveyard.name: The Cairn Remembers
town:graveyard.text: Near the end the dead hesitate: their units get -1/-0 for the rest of the fight.
town:graveyard.line: The dead stop. They look at your hands as if they have seen them before.

rule.name: The Cairn Remembers
rule.text: The dead hesitate: their units get -1/-0.

town:graveyard.banner: The dead hesitate: their units get -1/-0.

town:ninja.name: SMOKE BOMB!!!
town:ninja.text: At half health Shiro throws a smoke bomb: your strongest ready unit is exhausted and misses your next turn.
town:ninja.line: SMOKE BOMB!!! The oldest trick in the book. Page one. I wrote page one.
town:ninja.banner: Your strongest ready unit is lost in the smoke until after your next turn.

town:ninja.name: Body Double
town:ninja.text: Near the end Shiro swaps places with a log: the next 4 damage to him is absorbed.
town:ninja.line: You hit a log. A very convincing log. I gave it my eyebrows.
town:ninja.banner: Shiro's log absorbs the next 4 damage.

town:vault.name: The Seal of Iron Breaks
town:vault.text: At half health the first seal breaks and the Warden gathers the pieces: the next 3 damage to it is absorbed.
town:vault.line: One seal. One Path. The hand is real. Show me the rest of it.
town:vault.banner: The Warden gathers the broken seal: the next 3 damage is absorbed.

town:vault.name: The Last Seal
town:vault.text: Near the end the last seal opens: the Warden's units get -1/-0 for the rest of the fight.
town:vault.line: The last seal opens. The Paths agreed to bury this. They also agreed you might come.

rule.name: Seals Spent
rule.text: The seals are spent: the Warden's units get -1/-0.

town:old_well.name: Ripples
town:old_well.text: At half health the water answers: two 1/1 Ripples rise on the Echo's side.
town:old_well.line: ...you were here... you were small... the water remembers the shape of you...
town:old_well.banner: Two 1/1 Ripples rise from the well.

town:old_well.name: Still Water
town:old_well.text: Near the end the spring gathers itself: the Echo heals 3.
town:old_well.line: ...not yet... the spring runs once more...

zone:gourmand:casserole.name: Honour Duel
zone:gourmand:casserole.text: At half health Colonel Casserole demands a proper duel: his units get +1/+1 for the rest of the fight.
zone:gourmand:casserole.line: En garde, traveller. A duel of honour. Lids up. Yes, Chef.

rule.name: Honour Duel
rule.text: Casserole fights with honour: his units get +1/+1.

zone:final:spotless.name: HALT
zone:final:spotless.text: At half health Spotless barks an order: your strongest ready unit stands to attention (exhausted).
zone:final:spotless.line: HALT. Stand at attention. No: at THAT attention.
zone:final:spotless.banner: Your strongest ready unit is exhausted.

Vivienne Quota, Minister of Efficiency.name: Efficiency Review
Vivienne Quota, Minister of Efficiency.text: At half health Quota reviews her numbers: she draws a card.
Vivienne Quota, Minister of Efficiency.line: Your performance: forty-one percent of acceptable. Mine is about to improve.

capital:quota.name: Mandatory Break
capital:quota.text: At half health Quota's own break schedule kicks in: she draws a card, and her units take a two-minute break (exhausted through her next turn).
capital:quota.line: Two-minute break. Mandatory. I wrote the schedule. I resent the schedule.
capital:quota.banner: Quota draws a card; her units take a break through her next turn.

Trophy Hall Honor Guard.name: Empty Trophy
Trophy Hall Honor Guard.text: At half health a reserve guard steps off a pedestal: a 1/1 Militia joins.
Trophy Hall Honor Guard.line: This trophy is reserved. For the Chancellor. For anyone but you.
Trophy Hall Honor Guard.banner: A 1/1 Reserve Guard steps off a pedestal.

Chancellor Clench, Iron Regent.name: Brownout
Chancellor Clench, Iron Regent.text: On his 5th turn Clench cuts the wheel power: your two strongest ready units are exhausted and cannot block that turn.
Chancellor Clench, Iron Regent.line: CUT THE POWER. Everyone off the wheels. Nobody moves unless I say REP.
Chancellor Clench, Iron Regent.warn: Next turn: Clench cuts the power (your two strongest units cannot block).
Chancellor Clench, Iron Regent.banner: The lights go out: your two strongest ready units are exhausted.

Chancellor Clench, Iron Regent.name: DROP AND GIVE ME FORMS
Chancellor Clench, Iron Regent.text: At half health Clench pulls the emergency reserve: he gains 2 Iron.
Chancellor Clench, Iron Regent.line: Strength is control. Control is paperwork. Paperwork is HEAVY. Two more plates!

Chancellor Clench, Iron Regent.name: Master...?
Chancellor Clench, Iron Regent.text: Near the end Clench falters: his units get -1/-0 for the rest of the fight.
Chancellor Clench, Iron Regent.line: You said I would go further than you. Look how far I went. ...Master?

Baron Quadzilla.name: Final Set
Baron Quadzilla.text: At half health the Baron starts his final set: his units get +1/+0 for the rest of the fight.
Baron Quadzilla.line: Nobody. Skips. Leg day. (rep) Final set. (rep) In my cave.

rule.name: Final Set
rule.text: The Baron's final set: his units get +1/+0.

Baron Quadzilla.name: He Stands Up
Baron Quadzilla.text: Near the end the Baron stands for the first time in years: he heals 2, and wobbles (his units get -1/-0).
Baron Quadzilla.line: Standing. Huh. Wobbly. Like a first rep.

rule.name: Wobbly
rule.text: Standing up is hard: his units get -1/-0.

Baron Quadzilla.banner: The Baron heals 2, but his units get -1/-0.

The Ancient Spotter.name: One More Rep
The Ancient Spotter.text: At half health the Spotter catches the weight: it heals 4.
The Ancient Spotter.line: Lift. I will catch it. I have always caught it.

The Ancient Spotter.name: Young Spotters
The Ancient Spotter.text: On its 6th turn two 1/1 Young Spotters climb up to help it.
The Ancient Spotter.line: Never lift alone. Not even me.
The Ancient Spotter.warn: Next turn: two Young Spotters climb up the mountain.

Unfinished War Machine.name: Self-Repair
Unfinished War Machine.text: When three of its units have been scrapped, the machine patches itself: it heals 2.

Cannon-Blender Gunner.name: Full Blend
Cannon-Blender Gunner.text: On its 4th turn the cannon-blender fires a full load: you take 2 damage.
Cannon-Blender Gunner.line: Load the smoothie! Purée setting! FIRE!
Cannon-Blender Gunner.warn: Next turn: the cannon-blender fires a full load (2 damage).

The Doppelganger.name: The Mask Slips
The Doppelganger.text: At half health the disguise slips: Perfect Copy ends (its units lose +1/+1), and two 1/1 Sashimi Weenies are rushed out.
The Doppelganger.line: Delicious. Delicious. I have been told that is the word. ...Why will it not stay on?
The Doppelganger.banner: Perfect Copy ends. Two 1/1 Sashimi Weenies are rushed out.

The Doppelganger.name: No Face of Its Own
The Doppelganger.text: Near the end the face it wore is gone: its units get -1/-0 for the rest of the fight.
The Doppelganger.line: You never taste your own soup, do you? ...Neither do I. I cannot.

rule.name: Faceless
rule.text: No face of its own: its units get -1/-0.

The Doppelganger.banner: The Doppelganger falters: its units get -1/-0.

The Itamae Supreme.name: Omakase
The Itamae Supreme.text: On his 4th turn the Itamae serves you a course, as the custom is: you heal 2.
The Itamae Supreme.warn: Next turn: the Itamae serves the next course.
The Itamae Supreme.banner: The Itamae serves you: you heal 2.

The Itamae Supreme.name: ...Enough.
The Itamae Supreme.text: Near the end the Itamae sets down his knife: his units get -1/-0 for the rest of the fight.

rule.name: The Last Course
rule.text: The knife is down: his units get -1/-0.

Colonel Cornelius Crumb, Director of Cul.name: Battle Rations
Colonel Cornelius Crumb, Director of Cul.text: At half health Crumb issues paste: he gains 2 Ingredients.
Colonel Cornelius Crumb, Director of Cul.line: Battle rations! Taste is a weakness. Paste is a strategy!

Colonel Cornelius Crumb, Director of Cul.name: Paste Barrage
Colonel Cornelius Crumb, Director of Cul.text: On his 6th turn the vats open fire: you take 2 damage.
Colonel Cornelius Crumb, Director of Cul.line: Battle stations! This is not a drill, it is a soufflé!
Colonel Cornelius Crumb, Director of Cul.warn: Next turn: Crumb orders a paste barrage (2 damage).

Notary Wraith.name: In Triplicate
Notary Wraith.text: At half health the Wraith notarizes a Red Tape for itself.
Notary Wraith.line: Signed. Witnessed. Notarized. In triplicate. One copy is for you. You may not keep it.
Notary Wraith.banner: The Notary Wraith gains a Red Tape.

Undersecretary Vellum.name: Noted.
Undersecretary Vellum.text: At half health Vellum files an objection: he gains a Contract.

Mortimer Grimsby, CE-No.name: Mortimer Files a Form
Mortimer Grimsby, CE-No.text: On his 4th turn Mortimer files Form 27-B: a 1/1 Filing Clerk is hired to process it.
Mortimer Grimsby, CE-No.line: Your appeal has been received, reviewed and denied. It was a very good appeal.
Mortimer Grimsby, CE-No.warn: Next turn: Mortimer files Form 27-B (a clerk is hired).

Mortimer Grimsby, CE-No.name: Filed on a Tuesday
Mortimer Grimsby, CE-No.text: Late in the fight Mortimer finds a note under his own form: FILED ON A TUESDAY. His units get -1/-0 for the rest of the fight.
Mortimer Grimsby, CE-No.line: The authorization is valid. It was filed on a Tuesday. ...We do not file on Tuesdays.

rule.name: Filed on a Tuesday
rule.text: An irregular filing: his units get -1/-0.

Mortimer Grimsby, CE-No.banner: Mortimer hesitates over the form: his units get -1/-0.

Betty Bones, Surly Secretary.name: Forms A Through F
Betty Bones, Surly Secretary.text: At half health Betty hands over forms A through F: she gains 2 Contracts and a 1/1 Zombie Temp files in.
Betty Bones, Surly Secretary.line: Forms A through F. Then we'll talk. We won't, but still.
Betty Bones, Surly Secretary.banner: Betty gains 2 Contracts; a 1/1 Zombie Temp files in.

Betty Bones, Surly Secretary.name: Out to Lunch
Betty Bones, Surly Secretary.text: On her 5th turn Betty takes her lunch break: her units stand down (exhausted) for that turn, because nothing gets done on lunch.
Betty Bones, Surly Secretary.line: I'm on lunch. Nothing happens on lunch. That includes me.
Betty Bones, Surly Secretary.warn: Next turn: Betty goes on lunch (her units stand down for a turn).
Betty Bones, Surly Secretary.banner: Betty is on lunch: her units are exhausted this turn.

Hortensia Clipwell, Royal Groundskeeper.name: Regulation Topiary
Hortensia Clipwell, Royal Groundskeeper.text: At half health Clipwell trims two topiaries into guards: two 1/1 Topiaries join her (Prize Topiary makes them 2/2).
Hortensia Clipwell, Royal Groundskeeper.line: Such a pretty weed. Such a shame. Now, stand still while I tidy you.

Hive of Mutant Bees.name: The Hive Swarms
Hive of Mutant Bees.text: When two of its units have died, the hive swarms: two 1/1 Mutant Bees with Flying buzz in.
Hive of Mutant Bees.banner: Two 1/1 flying Mutant Bees buzz in.

Compostella, the Rotheart.name: The Roots Spread
Compostella, the Rotheart.text: At half health the roots spread: two 1/1 Sporelings sprout and her units get +0/+1.
Compostella, the Rotheart.line: ...I am the bin you never empty... nothing leaves... I am HUNGRY...
Compostella, the Rotheart.banner: Two Sporelings sprout; her units get +0/+1.

Compostella, the Rotheart.name: Please. The Tree.
Compostella, the Rotheart.text: Near the end a small voice breaks through: her units get -1/-0 for the rest of the fight.
Compostella, the Rotheart.line: (small) Please. The tree. I could not let her go.

rule.name: Letting Go
rule.text: The small voice: her units get -1/-0.

Compostella, the Rotheart.banner: The hungry green falters: her units get -1/-0.

His Majesty the Raccoon.name: The Royal Bins
His Majesty the Raccoon.text: At half health the royal guard of bins rallies: a 1/1 Rat joins and he gains a Garbage.
His Majesty the Raccoon.line: WE DID NOT EAT THE COMPOST. We... audited it. Orally. GUARDS!
His Majesty the Raccoon.banner: A 1/1 Rat joins; His Majesty gains a Garbage.

His Majesty the Raccoon.name: Sweating Profusely
His Majesty the Raccoon.text: Near the end His Majesty starts to sweat: his units get -1/-0 for the rest of the fight.
His Majesty the Raccoon.line: The compost was for the kingdom. We are the kingdom. Checkmate. ...Is it warm in here?

rule.name: Sweating
rule.text: His Majesty is sweating: his units get -1/-0.

Enforcer Captain Spotless.name: Inspection
Enforcer Captain Spotless.text: On his 5th turn Spotless inspects your ranks: your strongest ready unit stands to attention (exhausted) and cannot block.
Enforcer Captain Spotless.line: INSPECTION. Height! Smudges! Smiles at the regulation angle!
Enforcer Captain Spotless.warn: Next turn: Spotless holds an inspection (your strongest unit cannot block).
Enforcer Captain Spotless.banner: Your strongest ready unit stands to attention.

Enforcer Captain Spotless.name: A SMUDGE
Enforcer Captain Spotless.text: Near the end Spotless notices a smudge on himself: his units get -1/-0 while he polishes.
Enforcer Captain Spotless.line: A SMUDGE. Is TREASON. ...It's on me, isn't it.

rule.name: Polishing
rule.text: Spotless is polishing: his units get -1/-0.

Mirror Knight.name: Reflection
Mirror Knight.text: At half health a reflection steps out of the glass: a 1/1 Reflection joins (Polished makes it 4/2).
Mirror Knight.line: Every mirror in this hall agrees with His Perfection. So does this one.
Mirror Knight.banner: A Reflection steps out of the glass.

Royal Staircase Guard.name: Hold the Stair
Royal Staircase Guard.text: At half health the guard plants his feet: the next 3 damage to him is absorbed.
Royal Staircase Guard.line: No one climbs. The stair has been polished. By seventeen people.
Royal Staircase Guard.banner: The guard absorbs the next 3 damage.

Percival Plume, Deputy Minister of Good.name: Positive Spin
Percival Plume, Deputy Minister of Good.text: At half health Plume announces that he is fine: he heals 2.
Percival Plume, Deputy Minister of Good.line: Great news, citizens! I have been approved to feel fine!

Clocktower Sentinel.name: The Hour Strikes
Clocktower Sentinel.text: On its 4th turn the clock strikes: your two strongest ready units are exhausted and cannot block that turn.
Clocktower Sentinel.line: BONG. The hour has been standardized. All movement will now cease.
Clocktower Sentinel.warn: Next turn: the hour strikes (your two strongest units cannot block).
Clocktower Sentinel.banner: The hour strikes: your two strongest ready units are exhausted.

Primm (standardization).name: Out of Alignment
Primm (standardization).text: At half health Primm corrects the room: the next 2 damage to him is absorbed.
Primm (standardization).line: Do hold still. You are very slightly out of alignment. There. Better.

Primm (reflection).name: Every Mirror Agrees
Primm (reflection).text: On his 5th turn a polished reflection steps out to stand with him: a 2/2 Reflection.
Primm (reflection).line: Every mirror in this castle agrees with me. I find that very restful.
Primm (reflection).warn: Next turn: a reflection steps out of the mirrors.

Primm (unraveling).name: I Only Wanted It to Be Nice
Primm (unraveling).text: Near the end Primm comes apart: his units get -1/-0 for the rest of the fight.
Primm (unraveling).line: I only wanted it to be nice. For everyone. For their own good.

rule.name: Unraveling
rule.text: Primm is coming apart: his units get -1/-0.

The Failed Experiment.name: Mutation
The Failed Experiment.text: At half health the experiment sheds a piece of itself: a 1/1 Discarded Sample crawls out.
The Failed Experiment.line: GRRRK. (The tag on its wrist reads: BATCH 12. DISCONTINUED.)

The Drain Warden.name: Drain Cycle
The Drain Warden.text: On its 4th turn the drain cycle runs: you take 2 damage and the Warden heals 2.
The Drain Warden.line: Cycle four. Subject output nominal. Begin extraction.
The Drain Warden.warn: Next turn: the drain cycle runs (you lose 2, it heals 2).
The Drain Warden.banner: You take 2 damage; the Drain Warden heals 2.

Dr. Ambrose Siphon, Chief Path-ologist.name: This Will Only Drain a Little
Dr. Ambrose Siphon, Chief Path-ologist.text: At half health Siphon opens a valve: you take 2 damage and he heals 2.
Dr. Ambrose Siphon, Chief Path-ologist.line: This will only drain a little. You've grown, Subject 1. Remarkable.

Dr. Ambrose Siphon, Chief Path-ologist.name: Fascinating Data
Dr. Ambrose Siphon, Chief Path-ologist.text: Near the end Siphon takes notes: he draws 2 cards.
Dr. Ambrose Siphon, Chief Path-ologist.line: Fascinating. My finest work, fighting back. I must write this down.

The Old Kingdom Automaton.name: Recalibrate
The Old Kingdom Automaton.text: At half health the Automaton recalibrates: the next 3 damage to it is absorbed.
The Old Kingdom Automaton.banner: The Automaton absorbs the next 3 damage.

The Old Kingdom Automaton.name: Recognised
The Old Kingdom Automaton.text: Near the end the Automaton hesitates: its units get -1/-0 for the rest of the fight.

rule.name: Recognised
rule.text: The Automaton hesitates: its units get -1/-0.

The Old Kingdom Automaton.banner: The Automaton hesitates: its units get -1/-0.

arena:arena_spells_only.name: Getting Soggy
arena:arena_spells_only.text: At half health the Colossus gets soggy: its units get -1/-0 for the rest of the fight.
arena:arena_spells_only.line: THE COLOSSUS IS... DAMP! (normal voice) Someone left the mop bucket out again.
arena:arena_spells_only.banner: The Colossus is soggy: its units get -1/-0.

arena:arena_four_fists.name: The Fourth Fist
arena:arena_four_fists.text: At half health the Champion uses its fourth fist: its units get +1/+0 for the rest of the fight.
arena:arena_four_fists.line: THE CHAMPION RAISES ITS FOURTH FIST! (normal voice) Nobody knows where it keeps it.

rule.name: Fourth Fist
rule.text: All four fists: its units get +1/+0.

arena:arena_marshal.name: THE CROWD GOES WILD
arena:arena_marshal.text: On his 3rd turn the crowd joins in: a 1/1 Rowdy Fan climbs into the ring.
arena:arena_marshal.line: THE CROWD! GOES! WILD! (normal voice) Please stay behind the rope. There is a rope.
arena:arena_marshal.warn: Next turn: a fan climbs into the ring.
arena:arena_marshal.banner: A 1/1 Rowdy Fan climbs into the ring.

arena:arena_marshal.name: INTERMISSION
arena:arena_marshal.text: At half health Bellows calls an intermission: he heals 2, and his units sit down through his next turn.
arena:arena_marshal.line: INTERMISSION! (normal voice) I'm having soup. THE SOUP IS WINNING.
arena:arena_marshal.banner: Bellows heals 2; his units sit out his next turn.
